summary: Iteration 2 retest of the iteration_1 fixes plus new features. Backend: 27 pytest tests (20 regression + 7 new); 26 pass. Invalid dates now return 400 everywhere: 2026-13-01 and 2026-02-30 as query params on /occurrences, group occurrences and free-days, and 2026-02-31 / 2026-04-31 in plan date, start_date and end_date on POST and PUT, and in meeting POST and PUT. Free days now keep days that have a meeting of the same group and attach {id,title}. A day with a meeting of another group the member attends still counts as busy. When the owner leaves, ownership passes to another member. When the last member leaves, the group and its meetings are deleted. Admin remove-member works. The one failure: admin DELETE /admin/users/{uid} skips the new remove_member logic, so owner_id is left pointing to the deleted user and groups with 0 members are not deleted. Frontend at 375x667: opening a meeting (meeting-open-*) no longer crashes; the sheet opens pre-filled. Editing place, notes and minutes then saving updates the card (18:45, TEST_Kawiarnia, TEST_notatka). Delete works: Odwołaj -> Na pewno? -> card removed, toast 'Spotkanie odwołane'. All 4 hour/minute inputs in the plan and meeting sheets are 61px wide and fit inside 375px, with no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 375). The free-days tab shows 'Zaplanowane: TEST_kino' on the meeting day and tapping it goes to /meetings. RSVP Idę updates counts to 2 and the meeting shows in Mój plan. Adding a plan via the FAB with minutes 07:15-08:45 saves. The admin remove-member confirmation sheet ('Usunąć z grupy?') appears and Usuń removes the member. A non-admin opening /admin sees 'Tylko dla administratora'. No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages.

minor.issue: Doesn't use the new remove_member() helper. It only $pull's member_ids, so when the deleted user was the owner, owner_id points to a missing user, and a group whose last member is deleted stays as an empty orphan with its meetings. Also active_group_id cleanup and orphan meetings aren't handled. Fix: for each group containing uid, call await remove_member(g, uid) before deleting the user. Reference: backend/server.py:595-605

meeting_by_date keeps only one meeting per date (the last one in the dict wins). With 2 meetings on the same day only one is shown, and the free-day card has no 'propose' button for that day. Low priority.

issues: Non-admins still see the Użytkownicy (0)/Grupy (0) segmented control and 'Brak dostępu'. The error text only reflects users.error, so the Grupy tab shows a plain empty list. Consider redirecting non-admins away or hiding the tabs. Cosmetic.

action_items: In admin_delete_user (server.py:595), loop over groups containing uid and call remove_member(g, uid) so ownership is reassigned and empty groups and their meetings are deleted. Re-run test_iteration2_fixes.py::TestIteration2::test_admin_delete_owner_user_reassigns_owner.
Optional: free-days should support multiple meetings per day (return a list), or allow proposing another meeting on a day that already has one.
Optional: redirect non-admin users away from /admin, or hide the tabs when there's a 403.
critical_code_review_comments: meetings.tsx:168 now uses defaultDate={edit?.date ?? todayISO()}, and DateField re-syncs anchor in a useEffect while guarding against invalid dates. The crash is fixed.
Pickers.tsx timeInput: flex:1 + minWidth:0 + width:40 fixes the web overflow.
remove_member helper (server.py:249) handles empty group deletion and owner reassignment for leave and admin remove-member, but it isn't reused in admin_delete_user.
